title: Business Administration: Finance
credential: Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration degree: Finance

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Our program is a minimum-requirement major, with the required classes being the necessary prerequisites for some of the core classes.

High School Applicants. High School applicants applying to UW Bothell with a minimum 3.00 GPA who list Business Administration as their intended major are admitted to the major.

All Other Applicants. To be admitted into the program, current UW Bothell pre-major students, UW Bothell students in other majors, and transfer students must have a minimum cumulative GPA of at least 3.00, with a minimum grade of 1.7 in each:

• Statistics (4-5 credits): BIS 215, or B BUS 215, or B MATH 215, or STAT 220 or QMETH 201

• Microeconomics (5 credits): B BUS 220/BIS 200 or ECON 200

• Advanced Composition (5 credits): B WRIT 135 or ENGL 141 or equivalent (C) course

For students admitted into UW Bothell from high school but who either did not meet the 3.00 GPA minimum for direct admission or who did not list the Business Administration major as first choice at the time of applying to UW Bothell must meet the minimum requirements, as stated above, to declare the Business Administration major.
sourceText.degree-completion:
Completion Requirements

Completion of 90 credits or more at the upper-division level (300-400)

Completion of at least 60 credits in business, with a minimum of 45 credits at UW Bothell
45 of the final 60 credits must be completed in residence at UW Bothell
Minimum 1.7 grade in courses applied to the major

Required Business Core (69-70 Credits)

BIS 215, or B BUS 215, or B MATH 215, or STAT 220 or QMETH 201- Statistics (4 or 5 credits)

B BUS 220/BIS 200 or ECON 200- Microeconomics

B WRIT 135 or ENGL 141 or equivalent (C) course- Advanced Composition

B BUS 221/BIS 201 or ECON 201- Macroeconomics

B BUS 210 or ACCTG 215- Financial Accounting

B BUS 211 or ACCTG 225- Managerial Accounting

B BUS 230 or MGMT 200- Business Law

STMATH 124 or MATH 124 or STMATH 114 or B MATH 144 or MATH 112- Calculus 1

B BUS 300 - Organizational Behavior, Ethics, and Inclusivity

B BUS 307 - Business Writing

B BUS 310 - Managerial Economics

B BUS 320 - Marketing Management

B BUS 340 - Operations and Project Management

B BUS 350 - Business Finance

Capstone (10 Credits)
B BUS 470 - Business Policy and Strategic Management
B BUS 480 - Global Environment of Business

Finance Option Core (20 Credits)

B BUS 451 - Financial Policy and Practice

B BUS 452 - Financial Modeling

B BUS 453 - Financial Institutions and Markets

B BUS 454 - Investments

Finance Option Enrichment Elective (5 Credits)

Choose one course for 5 credits total. See department website for a list of accepted courses

Finance Option Elective (10 Credits)

Choose two courses for 10 credits total. See department website for a list of accepted courses

Upper Division Coursework (5 Credits)
Any 300‐400 level classes at UW Bothell or approved comparable upper-division transfer courses, excluding any 300-400 level courses used for the Reasoning Requirement. A second business concentration or a minor may be completed.

-Some Required Business Core courses may be taken as transfer coursework or prior to entering the Business Administration Major
